title: historical dependency direction from 534brn into the foreground sticker puzzle
historical_sequence: The nine-piece CE background puzzle was solved first and yielded dat/534brn9653f9j8mmd.
The three-symbol foreground puzzle remained unsolved after that handoff.
On 2 Nov 2025, community discussion explicitly argued that Playdead likely expected solvers to obtain the 534 puzzle first because the foreground sticker puzzle required much more effort.
The same discussion explicitly proposed that the 534 solution could be intended as an aid to the sticker puzzle and noticed its nine decimal digits.
operation_class: prior-stage output reused as parameter/key/registration aid for a later sticker layer
relation_to_current_candidate: This independently supports the direction 534brn -> foreground rather than treating the URL digits as a post-hoc external resemblance.
limits: No historical source specifies keypad-row extraction.
No historical source specifies the final 90-degree CCW axis swap.
No source proves that the nine digits rather than another part of the 534 artifact are the intended aid.
conclusion: The cross-stage direction required by Experiments 378-383 has independent historical provenance. The exact consumer remains unresolved, but using a 534-derived parameter on the foreground is no longer a purely model-generated dependency.
